bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to food support; appropriating money to food shelf programs.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; MINNESOTA FOOD SHELF PROGRAM. +]

[+$5,392,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for food shelf programs under Minnesota Statutes, section 142F.14. This appropriation is added to the base. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to food support; appropriating money to food shelf programs.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; MINNESOTA FOOD SHELF PROGRAM.

$5,392,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for food shelf programs under Minnesota Statutes, section 142F.14. This appropriation is added to the base.
additions: $5,392,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of children, youth, and families for food shelf programs under Minnesota Statutes, section 142F.14. This appropriation is added to the base.
